title: coelogyne eymae
intro: Coelogyne eymae, commonly known as the Coelogyne eymae orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to the tropical forests of Borneo and Sumatra. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, as well as its potential to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne eymae include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs, as well as its potential to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Coelogyne eymae include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
